news.title: Trump signs order to rename Lake Ontario 'Lake America' amid Canada trade war
news.description: President Donald Trump signed an executive order that he said will "immediately" change the name of Lake Ontario to "Lake America."

news.title: Fed's Hammack says 'now is the time to act' on raising interest rates
news.description: She still thinks the Fed needs to take action against inflation that is straining household budgets.

news.title: SK Hynix CEO says Indiana will be key memory production base by 2030, first U.S. facility now underway
news.description: At the groundbreaking ceremony for SK Hynix's first U.S. facility, CEO Kwak Noh-Jung says Indiana will be a key memory production base by 2030.
